description:
USP (Unique Selling Points):

  • Made with Natural Ingredients – Formulated without synthetics, parabens, sulfates, or artificial colors.
  • Essential Oil-Based – Products are crafted with pure essential oils for natural fragrance and wellness benefits.
  • Handcrafted in Small Batches – Artisan-made to ensure high quality and attention to detail.
  • Eco-Conscious & Sustainable – Prioritizes biodegradable ingredients and responsible packaging.
  • Cruelty-Free – Never tested on animals.
  • Mostly Vegan – All products are vegan except for lip and cuticle balms, which contain beeswax.
  • Holistic Wellness Approach – Designed to nourish the skin and promote overall well-being.
  • Infused with Botanicals & Herbs – Rich in plant extracts for enhanced skin and body care benefits.
  • DIY-Friendly – Offers pure essential oils and carrier oils for those who love making their own products.
  • Established & Trusted Brand – Bringing high-quality natural body care to customers since 1994.

Brand introduction:

Plantlife Natural Body Care products are the perfect blend of science and nature, using "old world" formulas combined with the timeless sciences of herbology and aromatherapy. Plantlife's mission is to consistently create all-natural body care products that are good for you, using the purest ingredients such as fresh herbs and 100% pure essential oils. Each of our therapeutic blends and aromatherapy creations is prepared with the intent of enriching our lives as well as our environment!

 
Product description:

  • Aromatherapy Products: A range of 100% pure essential oils, essential oil blends, and diffusers designed to promote well-being through the power of scent.

  • Bath & Body Care: Handcrafted bar soaps, body washes, body oils, bath salts, and face & body sprays made with pure essential oils and organic botanicals to nourish and moisturize the skin.

  • Skin & Hair Care: Products including clay masks, facial toners, hair oils, and cuticle balms formulated to support healthy skin and hair using natural ingredients.

  • DIY Ingredients: A selection of pure essential oils, carrier oils, and other natural ingredients for those interested in creating their own personal care products.

  • Gift Sets and Bundles: Curated sets of products ideal for gifting or exploring a variety of Plantlife's offerings

 
Payment terms:

Affiliates will receive a payout only when their commission balance reaches a minimum of $100. Payments are processed on the 10th of each month for all accounts that have met this threshold. If an affiliate's balance does not reach $100 in a given month, the earnings will roll over to the next month until the threshold is met. Payments will be issued via the affiliate’s selected payment method or by check. Plantlife reserves the right to withhold or adjust commissions for any fraudulent, canceled, or refunded transactions.
